name: Registry::index_message

test_list.description: A message passed to index_message is returned by search_history with its session, role and timestamp.
System, User, Assistant and Tool roles are stored and returned as the same role.
Indexing is allowed before the session is upserted (events may arrive first).
index_message_redacted applies the Redactor before storing: a seeded secret appears in no registry file (db, -wal, -shm) and the masked text is searchable.
Negative control for the secret scan: index_message stores text verbatim, so the same scan does find an unmasked secret.
Non-ASCII text (accents, CJK, emoji) is stored and found.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Message text; index_message expects it already masked, index_message_redacted masks it first.

output_description: Message text added to the FTS5 trigram index; only masked text is ever persisted.
